condition: When a custom type with a serialization schema from __get_pydantic_core_schema__ is used as the value type in __pydantic_extra__, extra-field values are serialized by inference, so the custom serializer is ignored and model_dump_json fails with "Unable to serialize unknown type".
workaround: Also set a class attribute __pydantic_serializer__ = SchemaSerializer(...) on the value's class, using the same serialization schema.
